reason: Stack-exhaustion DoS from deeply nested glob patterns. No patched braces release exists (3.0.3 is latest and affected). It reaches the tree only through build-time devDependencies (tailwindcss, @tailwindcss/typography, tailwindcss-animate via chokidar/fast-glob/micromatch, and typescript-eslint via fast-glob), which evaluate glob patterns from this repository's own config, never from users. Remove when braces ships a fix, or when typescript-eslint >= 8.71 and a Tailwind v4 migration drop the vulnerable chain.
